Kiro Web + GitHub: issue to pull request in 4 steps

Four steps to turn a GitHub issue into a pull request with Kiro.

1. Connect GitHub - Install Kiro's GitHub app.
2. Label the issue - Add the label kiro to an issue.
3. Or comment - Or comment /kiro.
4. Review the PR - The agent opens a pull request for you.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/web/github/
